title: Dirty-dataset generator and reference seed
objective: Build the adversarial fixture: assets labeled public domain but paraphrased or cropped, plus seed copyrighted corpus for the local index.
agent_steps: Implement scripts/generate_dirty_dataset.py: 30% synonym replacement for text; 85-95% crop, LANCZOS resize, autocontrast for images.
Seed 50 text and 50 image public-domain-reference assets; build the FAISS HNSW indexes and pHash dictionary.
Emit a manifest linking each dirty asset to its true source for assertion in tests.
Wire generation into CI fixtures so integration tests are reproducible.
acceptance_criteria: Generator output: 10 dirty text + 10 dirty image files with manifest.
Naive exact-hash matching catches zero dirty assets (proves evasion).
Reference indexes build deterministically from a fixed seed.
